Initialized empty set to first insertion advances 1 to 2. Synthetic catalog head revision advances 1 to 2 while its generation advances 7 to 8.
Duplicate deployment, wrong epoch, missing admission, unknown scope and nonpositive generation are rejected by actual constraints.
Bigint overflow rolls back the corresponding synthetic source mutation; stale expected generation does not change the counter.
limitations: The matrix installs no product fixture and grants no product access. Real participating writers and complete capture remain in their owning tasks.
The same raw upgrade run found T009 generation advancement twice in one transaction. T009 remains blocked even though this matrix passed.
Database evidence is isolated PostgreSQL, with no native Auth or clinical assessment.
